name: Vigil
description: This unit can designate one <@ba.kw>Tactical Point</> within attack range to call Reinforcements; ATK is increased to 150% when attacking enemies blocked by Reinforcements

candidates.name: Leader of the Wolfpack
candidates.description: Can summon a Wolfpack initially consisting of 2 'Wolf Shadows' at the Tactical Point to assist in combat; The number of 'Wolf Shadows' increases by 1 every 30 seconds (up to a maximum of 3; each 'Wolf Shadow' increases the Wolfpack's Block by 1 and causes its attacks to deal an additional instance of damage)
